title: Proposed Information Collection and Submission for Office of Management and Budget Review; Fiscal Responsibility Act TANF Pilot Program 2025 Information Collection
abstract: The Administration for Children and Families (ACF) is proposing to reissue an information collection to request information from interested states for the Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 (FRA) Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) pilot program. This request is proposed under Office of Management and Budget (OMB) #: 0970-0531 and is a reissuing of a previously approved information collection to select states for the FRA pilot program.
